items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] So was Seminole the first person you heard play the xylophone? [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, no.

ctx.x: If you sing it early, you know, before everybody is half high and they think about all the things their broad's done to them, then they come down. The fighting starts. I say, "Man, don't sing that goddamned song." There were two songs, "Stormy Weather" and that song, I never liked. Never liked them, never.
One musician I wanted to ask you about, too, that we mentioned before I started the interview, this guy, Seminole.
